nav.label: Main menu
sim.banner: Simulator mode: no real hardware is being touched
sim.title: Simulator scenarios
sim.help: Try what MoodNAS does when something goes wrong. Watch the eyes.
setup.intro: Your WD My Cloud EX4 now runs open, modern and secure software. Let's set it up in a minute.
setup.codeTitle: Prove you are next to the NAS
setup.codeHelp: Look at the front display of the NAS (or the system log). It shows an 8-character setup code. This stops anyone else on your network from claiming it first.
setup.footer: No default passwords. No cloud account required.
user.nameRules: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Must start with a letter.
user.passwordRules: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
mood.allGood: Everything is fine. Your data is safe and the disks are healthy.
mood.resting: Quiet hours: I keep the fan low and let the disks rest.
mood.warm: It is getting warm (CPU {cpu} °C, disks up to {disk} °C). I've turned up the fan.
mood.tooHot: Too hot! CPU {cpu} °C, disks {disk} °C. Fan at maximum. Check the ventilation.
mood.fillingUp: At the current pace the volume will be full in about {days} days.
mood.diskMediumRisk: The disk in bay {bay} shows early signs of wear ({pct}% risk). Keep your backups up to date.
mood.diskHighRisk: The disk in bay {bay} is likely to fail soon ({pct}% risk). Back up and replace it.
mood.arrayDegraded: RAID {array} is degraded: one disk has dropped out. Your data is still there, but with no safety margin.
mood.ransomware: Ransomware-like activity on "{share}". I froze it as read-only to protect your files.
fan.reason.rising: Temperature is rising: I spun the fan up before it gets hot.
fan.reason.quiet: Quiet hours: fan kept low while temperatures are safe.
panel.caption: Live preview of the NAS front display
fill.learning: Learning how fast you store data…
fill.stable: Usage is stable: no risk of filling up.
storage.name: Name
storage.compat: Volumes created by the original WD firmware are recognised as they are: no formatting, no migration.
risk.title: AI failure risk
risk.advice.medium: Not urgent, but make sure you have a recent backup.
risk.advice.high: Back up now and plan to replace this disk.
shares.help: Folders you can open from your computers (SMB) and phones.
shares.sentinelHelp: Protect with the ransomware sentinel (freeze if attacked)
shares.name: Name
shares.confirmDelete: Remove the shared folder "{name}"? The files stay on disk.
users.name: Name
ai.intro: Old hardware, new intelligence. Some features run entirely on the NAS; others use an AI model you choose. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you turn it on, and every request is listed below.
ai.assistantSub: Ask about your NAS in your own words
ai.suggest.disks: Should I worry about any disk?
ai.suggest.share: Create a shared folder called Photos for everyone
ai.assistantOff: The assistant is off. An administrator can turn it on in AI settings below.
ai.localSub: These models run on the EX4's own processor. No data leaves your home.
ai.privacySub: Every request that left the NAS for an AI provider.
ai.keyHelp: Stored only on the NAS and never shown again.
ai.ollamaHelp: A computer on your network running Ollama. Nothing leaves your home.
feature.diskrisk.help: Estimates each disk's risk of failing from its SMART data.
feature.sentinel.help: Spots mass encryption of files and freezes the share before it spreads.
feature.fan.help: Anticipates heat, and keeps quiet at night when it is safe.
feature.forecast.help: Learns how fast you store data and warns before the volume fills up.
feature.assistant.help: Ask questions and give instructions in natural language. Changes always need your confirmation.
feature.explain.help: Turns technical alerts into plain-language explanations (coming soon).
security.frozen: The share was frozen read-only. Nothing new can be written to it.
security.advice: Check the computers that use this folder for malware before unfreezing it. Earlier versions of your files are still in the snapshots.
system.defaultLangHelp: Used for new visitors. Each person can choose their own.
system.fanAiHelp: Anticipates temperature changes and keeps quiet during quiet hours.
system.safety: Safety first: whatever the setting, the fan goes to 100% if the CPU reaches 90 °C or a disk reaches 55 °C.
system.aboutText: MoodNAS is open-source firmware by Mood Robotics that gives the WD My Cloud EX4 a second life: a modern, secure system with built-in artificial intelligence.
account.pwChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
account.totpHelp: Ask for a code from your phone at sign-in, in addition to the password.
account.totpStep1: Open your authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…) and add this key, or open the link on your phone.
account.totpStep2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
error.network: Cannot reach the NAS. Check your connection.
auth.csrf: Security check failed. Reload the page.
auth.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
setup.badCode: The setup code is not correct.
setup.done: This NAS is already set up.
user.weakPassword: The password must be at least 10 characters.
user.cannotDeleteSelf: You cannot delete your own account.
share.exists: A shared folder with that name already exists.
share.invalidName: Invalid name: use up to 32 letters, digits, spaces, _ . -
settings.invalidHostname: Invalid name: lowercase letters, digits and -.
ai.disabled: The assistant is off. Turn it on in AI settings.
ai.noKey: Add an API key in AI settings.
ai.providerError: The AI provider did not answer: {detail}
ai.actionExpired: This action has expired. Ask again.
